messages:
Rajat (AE): Quick pass to CS for Atlas Labs — closed today. High level: Enterprise trial converting to Dedicated + Private VPC. ARR $220k ARR, expected 3 active product teams. Renewal 12 months from now but they want predictable latency and EU data residency.

Rajat (AE): Key asks from customer: SSO via SAML, private networking (VPC peering), model pinned to redwood-compat/gpt-large, burst to 200 qps during business hours, and an initial 90-day pilot. They asked for benchmks vs competitor on latency.

Maya (CSM): Thanks — assigning onboarding + health plan. I'll own kickoff and enablement. Need: contact for infra (ops@atlaslabs.com), expected prod start 2025-05-05, and PO status?

Rajat (AE): PO in progress, expected by 2025-04-28. Primary customer contacts: Caro (caro@atlaslabs.com) and Ken (ken@atlaslabs.com). Sales notes linked: https://redwood.sales/notes/atlas-1747

Evelyn (SE): Quick technical check — what model version & max context? Also confirm whether they want KV cache persisted across restarts. If private, we'll need to collect allowed CIDR and any port restrictions.

Rajat (AE): Model = redwood-compat/gpt-large@v2. Context target 8k, KV cache: yes persistent preferred. CIDR: 10.12.0.0/22 (they said) but will provide official network diagram this week.

Liam (Support): I'll open the network ticket and escalation path. Please post the exact CIDR + egress IPs when you have them. I'll also provision a staging cluster for smoke tests and endpoint access.

ps-bot: Support ticket created: SUP-12345 — "Atlas Labs private network onboarding" — https://redwood.support/tickets/SUP-12345

Maya (CSM): Onboarding plan (short):
- Kickoff call (owner: Maya) — target 2025-04-30
- SSO setup (owner: Sofia (AM) + Atlas IdP) — due 2025-05-07
- Network allowlist & staging access (owner: Liam) — ticket SUP-12345 -> due 2025-05-02
- Model pin + perf baseline (owner: Evelyn) — baseline by 2025-05-09
- PS scoping for KV persistence & burst (owner: Maya + Evelyn) — estimate by 2025-05-06

Maya (CSM): Renewal risk notes: medium. Risk drivers = SSO delays, PO timing, and perf unknown vs their SLA. We'll capture usage during pilot and set a rollback/fallback routing if latency > 250ms for more than 5% of requests.

Evelyn (SE): For perf baseline, please run this quick smoke load against staging once Liam exposes it:
```
ab -n 1000 -c 20 https://staging-atlas.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
Also, plan quantization tests: try q4_0 and q4_1 for cost/latency tradeoffs.

Liam (Support): Noted. I'll attach logs and run initial smoke. Linking ticket updates here as progress: https://redwood.support/tickets/SUP-12345/updates

Sofia (AM): I'll coordinate SSO details with Caro and push on PO. Will update the thread when IdP metadata is ready.

Maya (CSM): Next steps for CS->Eng escalation: if baseline latency >250ms or 10%+ error rate during baseline, tag eng-runtime and @Evelyn for immediate triage. If networking blocks provisioning for >3 business days, escalate to eng-infra.

Rajat (AE): Thanks team — happy to jump on any triage calls. Caro is amenable to a joint session the week of 2025-05-05.

Maya (CSM): I'll schedule kickoff and create a shared runbook doc. Adding short feedback capture: schedule 2-week check-ins during pilot and a formal NPS/feature survey at 60 days.

Evelyn (SE): Added a quick checklist for CS to collect pre-kickoff: IDP metadata, allowed CIDRs, expected peak qps window, example prompts & bounding tokens.

Maya (CSM): Perfect — leaving owners on each line. Will update statuses in this thread. :thumbsup:
